user.title: Set up HA Insights
user.description: HA Insights observes your home state to suggest automations. Pick how (or whether) the LLM enrichment surface works. You can change this later in Configure.

cloud_consent.title: Cloud LLM — confirm data flow
cloud_consent.description:
Cloud LLMs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) live outside your home network. With pseudonymization on by default, real entity names and area names never leave; numeric values are bucketed; sensitive attributes (GPS, MAC, tokens, passwords) are always stripped. Every outbound call is recorded in the privacy log sensor.

Local LLM is recommended if available. Continue with cloud anyway?

data.cloud_consent: I understand and want to enable cloud LLM enrichment

init.title: HA Insights settings
init.description: Tune privacy mode, notifications, the daily digest, and your preferred LLM agent. Switching INTO Cloud LLM mode requires re-confirming the data-flow consent.

cloud_consent.title: Confirm cloud data flow
cloud_consent.description: Pseudonymized data will be sent to your configured Cloud LLM agent. Real names never leave; sensitive attributes are stripped.
